name: Yeti Battle of Greenhat Peak
review:
A yeti showdown on 11 lines with wilds, Wild Attack spins and a bonus with sticky wilds.

Wild Attack spins can drop extra wilds in the base game, and in the bonus the wilds stick. Low volatility, 845x cap, 96.1% RTP. Frosty cartoon art and gentle maths make it an easy-going choice for a relaxed session.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
